prompt: What is wrong with the pale blue swatch the supplier sent?
promptZh: 供應商送來的淺藍色樣片有什麼問題？
evidence: the blue sample was made with a different material from the one in our order.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: the blue sample was made with a different material from the one in our order.

options.text: It was sent to the wrong customer.
options.zh: 它被寄給了錯誤的客戶。
options.whyZh: 對話沒有送錯人的情節，問題出在樣片材料。

options.text: It uses a different material from the one in the order.
options.zh: 它採用的材料與訂單上的材料不同。
options.whyZh: 女方直接說藍色樣片不是用訂單指定的材料做的。

options.text: It was lost after the supplier shipped it.
options.whyZh: 供應商已寄來三種顏色的樣片，藍色樣片也在其中。

options.text: It is darker than the shade of blue the customer chose.
options.zh: 它的藍色比客戶選的色調更深。
options.whyZh: 女方說的是樣片材料不符訂單，沒說藍色太深。

explanationZh: 女方直接說藍色樣片不是用訂單指定的材料做的。

vocabulary.note: 用於檢查顏色或材質的小片實物。
